subject.title: feat(telegram): open the OpenClaw dashboard as a Telegram Mini App

question: Should OpenClaw support opening the admin Control UI as a Telegram Mini App, and if so what Telegram `initData`, Tailscale, credential lifetime, and framing boundary is acceptable?
rationale: The requested feature crosses Telegram, Gateway auth, Tailscale exposure, and the admin dashboard; automation can identify the missing path, but cannot decide the product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve Bounded Native-Client Flow
options.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned command/button that uses existing Tailscale Serve/Funnel URLs, verifies `initData`, and creates a short-lived Control UI session while documenting Telegram Web as unsupported initially.

options.title: Keep Manual Dashboard Access
options.body: Leave current explicit `webApp` buttons and `openclaw dashboard` flows as-is until a maintainer sponsors the admin webview auth model.

options.title: Require Broader Design First
options.body: Pause implementation until Gateway device-pairing and webview framing have a reusable external-app auth design instead of a Telegram-only path.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Native-Client Flow
recommendation.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned command/button that uses existing Tailscale Serve/Funnel URLs, verifies `initData`, and creates a short-lived Control UI session while documenting Telegram Web as unsupported initially.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the Telegram Mini App button support and the Control UI/Gateway security boundary touched by this request.
